story_type: boat to boat family transfer in a storm
hook: A six month old baby, passed between two rocking boats
narration: They had to pass a six month old baby between two rocking boats.
A family of four and their dog were aboard when the sailboat broke free from its mooring.
The mast was swinging so violently, the helicopter could not lower the swimmer onto the deck.
So he dropped into the sea and swam to the boat.
He climbed aboard, and the anchor was still holding.
Crews avoid hoisting from a sailboat when a swinging mast and cables can snag the line.
So they waited about thirty minutes for a boat to come alongside.
In heavy swells, they passed the family across one by one.
outcome: Everyone was rescued, the baby and dog included.
title: Baby passed between boats in a storm
description:
A Coast Guard rescue swimmer and the Santa Barbara Harbor Patrol rescued a family of four, including a six month old baby, and their dog after their sailboat broke free from its mooring off Santa Barbara, California, March 20, 2011.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Adam Eggers, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/133681/coast-guard-top-videos-2011-santa-barbara-rescue
